svg.title: I connect people, processes and systems. IT consultant and developer, growing into solution architecture. Animation in three frames. First a napkin sketch of a client question, 'Repairs take weeks. How do we fix that?', with ideas scribbled and crossed out: tenants calling becomes an app with a photo, AI sorts by urgency, the planner's excel sheet is crossed out for rules and AI, a contractor app, status updates to the tenant. Then the wena logo. Then the designed ArchiMate landscape: tenant and contractor, the report and plan repair processes, served by a tenant app on Static Web Apps, AI triage on Azure OpenAI, work orders on Logic Apps and a contractor app on App Service, all on an Azure platform with SQL Database, Service Bus, Key Vault, Monitor and Communication Services.
